description: JSONC configuration overrides built-in defaults. The parser also validates JSONC syntax, duplicate keys, and threshold ordering.

allowed-scopes.description: Allowed Scopes, matched exactly and case-sensitively. Setting this enables scope-enum unless overridden; an empty array permits no Scope.

scope-required.description: Enables the scope-required Rule; Rule-level enabled overrides it. Cannot be true with empty allowed-scopes.

types.description: Replaces the allowed Type list; matching is ASCII case-insensitive. Must be nonempty when type-enum is enabled.
